narrative.overview: The category standard for sports news, done properly: the craft level of The Athletic, ESPN, BBC Sport and Prothom Alo Sports. A black header band with the gold logo, a white page, a photo-led lead story, rounded grey story cards and black section blocks. White on every device; Bangla first.
keyCharacteristics: Black header band with a 3px gold rule; white page beneath.
Photo-led lead story with only the headline on the photo.
Rounded (10px) light-grey cards; small square thumbnails in lists.
Condensed display type for headlines in both languages.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only colour besides black, white and grey.

rules.name: The Caption-Only Rule
rules.body: On a photo, only the headline appears.

rules.name: The Bangla Spacing Rule
rules.body: Negative letter spacing applies to English only.

dos: Do lead with the newest story that has a photo.
Do keep only the headline on any photo.
Do show a logo tile when a story has no photo, so rows stay even.
Do keep the page white on every device.
Do keep tap targets at least 44px and text contrast at WCAG AA.
donts: Don't put standfirsts, dates or labels on a photo.
Don't add a dark mode or a second accent colour.
Don't place a small label above a headline; category and date go below it.
Don't use the federation's emblem or posing-figures motif.
Don't apply negative letter spacing to Bangla.
